task: PR #2705 replaces host-UTC accounting date defaults with one transaction-scoped company business date and makes driver-settlement cancellation atomic across canonical posting reversals, bills, bill payments, bank balance, driver bills, operational deductions, deduction buckets, GL reconciliation, settlement state, and audit. It reuses existing posting, journal-entry reversal, bill void, and deduction bucket reversal services; adds no GL math, schema, migration, QBO write-back, or flag change.

acceptance.check: One companyBusinessDate is captured per cancellation transaction and passed to every canonical reversal leg; explicit dates remain unchanged; UTC-midnight and DST behavior is deterministic.

Any GL, payment, bill, bank, driver-bill, deduction, bucket, settlement, or outer-audit failure rolls back the complete cancellation. A real PostgreSQL test injects the outer audit failure and compares every before/after state.

Attached driver_settlement_deductions are row-locked, detached exactly once, restored to pending with remaining_balance_cents=amount_cents, and their linked buckets are reversed exactly once through reverseDeductionFromBucket.

Before status transition, restored deduction count and amount agree with original and reversal deduction GL, all original/reversal journal entries net to zero by account/class/entity, and bill/payment/bank/driver-bill subledgers are fully restored.
